Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有很多人不知道什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃。有很多人吃植物以后就吃坏肚子了，因为他们吃了毒。那个时候，有一个老人叫神农，他什么植物都觉得好吃，不怕生病，不怕毒。他希望别人也可以吃好吃的植物。可是他知道，如果他们还怕吃毒，不会吃他喜欢的植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the description of people becoming ill, add one physical symptom to make the result more vivid, such as “很多人肚子疼得很厉害。”
2. When introducing 神农, add his purpose or determination, such as “神农决定找出哪些植物能吃。”
3. After 神农 hopes to help others, add a short thought to show his caring attitude, such as “神农想：我要帮助大家！”

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete symptom that fits people getting sick after eating poisonous plants.
This gives 神农 a clear goal that fits the traditional tale and this scene.
It repeats that 神农 hopes other people can eat good plants.
